description: ACCDB: qgdm held TableDefs collection fetched BEFORE SQL DDL: (1) db.Execute('CREATE TABLE S1 (ID LONG)') -> check held tds.Count, tds.Item('S1'), and fresh db.TableDefs.Count/Item BEFORE Refresh, then after Refresh; (2) hold s1=tds.Item('S1') & s1f=s1.Fields, db.Execute('ALTER TABLE S1 ADD COLUMN B LONG') -> check s1f.Count & s1f.Item('B') BEFORE and AFTER s1f.Refresh(); (3) db.Execute('DROP TABLE S1') -> check held tds.Count, tds.Item('S1'), s1.Name BEFORE and AFTER tds.Refresh(); (4) second handle db2 runs CREATE TABLE S2 / DROP TABLE S2 -> check db1 held tds BEFORE and AFTER Refresh. Keeps all pages.
